entities.rationale: Second stick figure drawn at lower left, outside the dashed CDN lines; has an arrow pointing into the CDN at the API Gateway level.

entities.name: CDN
entities.rationale: Area labelled 'CDN' delimited by two vertical dashed lines between the users and the AWS services; acts as the edge layer in front of S3, AppSync and API Gateway. No icon, hand-written label only.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Green bucket icon labelled 'S3' (AWS_Icon_6 at 805,215), to the right of the CDN dashed lines; connected to the CDN by a double-headed arrow.

entities.name: AppSync
entities.rationale: Red icon labelled 'APPSYNC' (AWS_Icon_5 at 809,380), to the right of the CDN; receives an arrow from the CDN and has arrows to Lambda and DynamoDB.

entities.name: API Gateway
entities.rationale: Purple icon labelled 'API GATEWAY' (AWS_Icon_1 at 800,600), to the right of the CDN; receives an arrow from the CDN and has a curved arrow up to Lambda.

entities.name: Lambda
entities.rationale: Orange icon labelled 'LAMBDA' (AWS_Icon_3 at 1005,386) in the centre; receives arrows from AppSync and API Gateway, connected to DynamoDB and SQS.

entities.name: DynamoDB
entities.rationale: Blue icon labelled 'DYNAMODB' (AWS_Icon_4 at 1201,385) on the right; double-headed arrow with Lambda and a direct line from AppSync routed over the top of Lambda.

entities.name: SQS
entities.rationale: Pink icon labelled 'SQS' (AWS_Icon_2 at 1082,592) below Lambda; one arrow from Lambda down to SQS and a curved arrow from SQS back up to Lambda.
